ART_RT.curation: Five local Staphylococcus RT seeds from the previous manifest; LPJP1 QXN67953.1 reconstructed from the paper's LPJP1 representative using RT homology, upstream repeat tract and downstream partner context.

Type_I_partner.curation: Provisional accession-level reconstruction of the partner downstream of LPJP1 array-associated RT QXN67953.1. The paper identifies LPJP1 as a type I representative. Single-locus retrieval seed, not an independently validated family alignment. Generic GNAT annotations are not used to select seeds.

Type_II_partner.curation: Co-oriented downstream partners of five paper-described Staphylococcus ART loci; MarsHill and SA1 held out as related-sequence recovery references.

Type_III_first_partner.curation: No traceable verified examples in the available inputs; remains a separate family slot. Supply curated seed_fasta and optional heldout_fasta paths to activate.

Type_III_second_partner.curation: No traceable verified examples in the available inputs; remains separate from the first gene. Supply curated seed_fasta and optional heldout_fasta paths to activate.
